mapper.select: select * from record where user_id = #{userId} order by date desc
select * from record where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into record (user_id, type, amount, category, description, date, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{category}, #{description}, #{date}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update record set type = #{type}, amount = #{amount}, category = #{category}, description = #{description}, date = #{date} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from record where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select * from record where user_id = #{userId} and date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} order by date desc
select * from record where user_id = #{userId} and YEAR(date) = #{year} and MONTH(date) = #{month} order by date desc
